name: Cable Lying Reverse Fly
steps: Center a flat bench between two high pulleys and grip the opposite handles.
Lie face up with your feet planted and arms crossed slightly above your chest.
Draw your hands apart in wide arcs with softly bent elbows until your arms reach bench height.
Pause briefly with your rear delts engaged, then return your hands above your chest under control.
tips: Keep the pull out to the sides without bending your elbows into a row.
Keep your shoulders pressed against the bench instead of shrugging toward your ears.
